outputs: Short summaries of input sentences preserving key information

guideline: Annotators compare fidelity and fluency of two summaries
Three options: first better, second better, equally good/bad
- Pairwise comparison with options: (i) first headline better, (ii) second headline better, (iii) both equally good/bad.
Annotators compare two system outputs and choose which is better in terms of fidelity and fluency, or indicate a tie.

changes_made.explanation: Consolidated and cleaned up guideline descriptions, added missing details about sample size and voting procedure

overall_notes: Paper focuses on unsupervised sentence summarization with word-level extraction. The extraction quality was generally good, but needed normalization of metric variants and removal of implementation details that aren't actual NLG models being evaluated. Paper includes strong emphasis on ROUGE metric sensitivity to length, which is an important NLG evaluation insight.
